scene.label: Act 5, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Another part of the forest

lines.text: How use doth breed a habit in a man!
lines.plainText: How use doth breed a habit in a man

lines.text: This shadowy desert, unfrequented woods,
lines.plainText: This shadowy desert unfrequented woods

lines.text: I better brook than flourishing peopled towns.
lines.plainText: I better brook than flourishing peopled towns

lines.text: Here can I sit alone, unseen of any,
lines.plainText: Here can I sit alone unseen of any

lines.text: And to the nightingale's complaining notes
lines.plainText: And to the nightingale's complaining notes

lines.text: Tune my distresses and record my woes.
lines.plainText: Tune my distresses and record my woes

lines.text: O thou that dost inhabit in my breast,
lines.plainText: O thou that dost inhabit in my breast

lines.text: Leave not the mansion so long tenantless,
lines.plainText: Leave not the mansion so long tenantless

lines.text: Lest, growing ruinous, the building fall
lines.plainText: Lest growing ruinous the building fall

lines.text: And leave no memory of what it was.
lines.plainText: And leave no memory of what it was

lines.text: Repair me with thy presence, Silvia;
lines.plainText: Repair me with thy presence Silvia

lines.text: Thou gentle nymph, cherish thy forlorn swain.
lines.plainText: Thou gentle nymph cherish thy forlorn swain

content.text: Enter Proteus, Silvia and Julia as Sebastian.

lines.text: Madam, this service I have done for you—
lines.plainText: Madam this service I have done for you

lines.text: Though you respect not aught your servant doth—
lines.plainText: Though you respect not aught your servant doth

lines.text: To hazard life, and rescue you from him
lines.plainText: To hazard life and rescue you from him

lines.text: That would have forced your honour and your love.
lines.plainText: That would have forced your honour and your love

lines.text: Vouchsafe me for my meed but one fair look;
lines.plainText: Vouchsafe me for my meed but one fair look

lines.text: A smaller boon than this I cannot beg,
lines.plainText: A smaller boon than this I cannot beg

lines.text: And less than this, I am sure, you cannot give.
lines.plainText: And less than this I am sure you cannot give

lines.text: [Aside.] How like a dream is this I see and hear!
lines.plainText: Aside How like a dream is this I see and hear

lines.text: Love, lend me patience to forbear awhile.
lines.plainText: Love lend me patience to forbear awhile

lines.text: O miserable, unhappy that I am!
lines.plainText: O miserable unhappy that I am

lines.text: Unhappy were you, madam, ere I came;
lines.plainText: Unhappy were you madam ere I came

lines.text: But by my coming I have made you happy.
lines.plainText: But by my coming I have made you happy

lines.text: By thy approach thou mak'st me most unhappy.
lines.plainText: By thy approach thou mak'st me most unhappy

lines.text: [Aside.] And me, when he approacheth to your presence.
lines.plainText: Aside And me when he approacheth to your presence

lines.text: Had I been seized by a hungry lion,
lines.plainText: Had I been seized by a hungry lion

lines.text: I would have been a breakfast to the beast
lines.plainText: I would have been a breakfast to the beast

lines.text: Rather than have false Proteus rescue me.
lines.plainText: Rather than have false Proteus rescue me

lines.text: O heaven, be judge how I love Valentine,
lines.plainText: O heaven be judge how I love Valentine

lines.text: Whose life's as tender to me as my soul!
lines.plainText: Whose life's as tender to me as my soul

lines.text: And full as much, for more there cannot be,
lines.plainText: And full as much for more there cannot be

lines.text: I do detest false perjured Proteus.
lines.plainText: I do detest false perjured Proteus

lines.text: Therefore be gone, solicit me no more.
lines.plainText: Therefore be gone solicit me no more

lines.text: What dangerous action, stood it next to death,
lines.plainText: What dangerous action stood it next to death

lines.text: Would I not undergo for one calm look!
lines.plainText: Would I not undergo for one calm look

lines.text: O, 'tis the curse in love, and still approved,
lines.plainText: O 'tis the curse in love and still approved

lines.text: When women cannot love where they're beloved.
lines.plainText: When women cannot love where they're beloved

lines.text: When Proteus cannot love where he's beloved.
lines.plainText: When Proteus cannot love where he's beloved

lines.text: Read over Julia's heart, thy first best love,
lines.plainText: Read over Julia's heart thy first best love

lines.text: For whose dear sake thou didst then rend thy faith
lines.plainText: For whose dear sake thou didst then rend thy faith

lines.text: Into a thousand oaths; and all those oaths
lines.plainText: Into a thousand oaths and all those oaths

lines.text: Descended into perjury to love me.
lines.plainText: Descended into perjury to love me

lines.text: Thou hast no faith left now, unless thou'dst two,
lines.plainText: Thou hast no faith left now unless thou'dst two

lines.text: And that's far worse than none; better have none
lines.plainText: And that's far worse than none better have none

lines.text: Than plural faith, which is too much by one.
lines.plainText: Than plural faith which is too much by one

lines.text: Thou counterfeit to thy true friend!
lines.plainText: Thou counterfeit to thy true friend

lines.text: In love
lines.plainText: In love

lines.text: Who respects friend?
lines.plainText: Who respects friend

lines.text: All men but Proteus.
lines.plainText: All men but Proteus

lines.text: Nay, if the gentle spirit of moving words
lines.plainText: Nay if the gentle spirit of moving words

lines.text: Can no way change you to a milder form,
lines.plainText: Can no way change you to a milder form

lines.text: I'll woo you like a soldier, at arms' end,
lines.plainText: I'll woo you like a soldier at arms' end

lines.text: And love you 'gainst the nature of love—force ye.
lines.plainText: And love you 'gainst the nature of loveforce ye

lines.text: O heaven!
lines.plainText: O heaven

lines.text: I'll force thee yield to my desire.
lines.plainText: I'll force thee yield to my desire

lines.text: [Comes forward.] Ruffian, let go that rude uncivil touch,
lines.plainText: Comes forward Ruffian let go that rude uncivil touch

lines.text: Thou friend of an ill fashion!
lines.plainText: Thou friend of an ill fashion

lines.text: Valentine!
lines.plainText: Valentine

lines.text: Thou common friend, that's without faith or love,
lines.plainText: Thou common friend that's without faith or love

lines.text: For such is a friend now. Treacherous man,
lines.plainText: For such is a friend now Treacherous man

lines.text: Thou hast beguiled my hopes; nought but mine eye
lines.plainText: Thou hast beguiled my hopes nought but mine eye

lines.text: Could have persuaded me. Now I dare not say
lines.plainText: Could have persuaded me Now I dare not say

lines.text: I have one friend alive; thou wouldst disprove me.
lines.plainText: I have one friend alive thou wouldst disprove me

lines.text: Who should be trusted, when one's right hand
lines.plainText: Who should be trusted when one's right hand

lines.text: Is perjured to the bosom? Proteus,
lines.plainText: Is perjured to the bosom Proteus

lines.text: I am sorry I must never trust thee more,
lines.plainText: I am sorry I must never trust thee more

lines.text: But count the world a stranger for thy sake.
lines.plainText: But count the world a stranger for thy sake

lines.text: The private wound is deepest. O time most accurst,
lines.plainText: The private wound is deepest O time most accurst

lines.text: 'Mongst all foes that a friend should be the worst!
lines.plainText: 'Mongst all foes that a friend should be the worst

lines.text: My shame and guilt confounds me.
lines.plainText: My shame and guilt confounds me

lines.text: Forgive me, Valentine; if hearty sorrow
lines.plainText: Forgive me Valentine if hearty sorrow

lines.text: Be a sufficient ransom for offence,
lines.plainText: Be a sufficient ransom for offence

lines.text: I tender 't here. I do as truly suffer
lines.plainText: I tender 't here I do as truly suffer

lines.text: As e'er I did commit.
lines.plainText: As e'er I did commit

lines.text: Then I am paid,
lines.plainText: Then I am paid

lines.text: And once again I do receive thee honest.
lines.plainText: And once again I do receive thee honest

lines.text: Who by repentance is not satisfied
lines.plainText: Who by repentance is not satisfied

lines.text: Is nor of heaven nor earth, for these are pleased;
lines.plainText: Is nor of heaven nor earth for these are pleased

lines.text: By penitence th' Eternal's wrath's appeased.
lines.plainText: By penitence th' Eternal's wrath's appeased

lines.text: And that my love may appear plain and free,
lines.plainText: And that my love may appear plain and free

lines.text: All that was mine in Silvia I give thee.
lines.plainText: All that was mine in Silvia I give thee

lines.text: O me unhappy!
lines.plainText: O me unhappy

lines.text: Look to the boy.
lines.plainText: Look to the boy

lines.text: Why, boy!
lines.plainText: Why boy

lines.text: Why, wag! How now? What's the matter? Look up; speak.
lines.plainText: Why wag How now What's the matter Look up speak

lines.text: O good sir, my master charged me to deliver a ring to Madam Silvia, which out of my neglect was never done.
lines.plainText: O good sir my master charged me to deliver a ring to Madam Silvia which out of my neglect was never done

lines.text: Where is that ring, boy?
lines.plainText: Where is that ring boy

lines.text: Here 'tis; this is it.
lines.plainText: Here 'tis this is it

lines.text: How, let me see.
lines.plainText: How let me see

lines.text: Why, this is the ring I gave to Julia.
lines.plainText: Why this is the ring I gave to Julia

lines.text: O, cry you mercy, sir, I have mistook.
lines.plainText: O cry you mercy sir I have mistook

lines.text: This is the ring you sent to Silvia.
lines.plainText: This is the ring you sent to Silvia

lines.text: But how cam'st thou by this ring? At my depart
lines.plainText: But how cam'st thou by this ring At my depart

lines.text: I gave this unto Julia.
lines.plainText: I gave this unto Julia

lines.text: And Julia herself did give it me,
lines.plainText: And Julia herself did give it me

lines.text: And Julia herself have brought it hither.
lines.plainText: And Julia herself have brought it hither

lines.text: How? Julia?
lines.plainText: How Julia

lines.text: Behold her that gave aim to all thy oaths
lines.plainText: Behold her that gave aim to all thy oaths

lines.text: And entertained 'em deeply in her heart.
lines.plainText: And entertained 'em deeply in her heart

lines.text: How oft hast thou with perjury cleft the root!
lines.plainText: How oft hast thou with perjury cleft the root

lines.text: O Proteus, let this habit make thee blush.
lines.plainText: O Proteus let this habit make thee blush

lines.text: Be thou ashamed that I have took upon me
lines.plainText: Be thou ashamed that I have took upon me

lines.text: Such an immodest raiment, if shame live
lines.plainText: Such an immodest raiment if shame live

lines.text: In a disguise of love.
lines.plainText: In a disguise of love

lines.text: It is the lesser blot, modesty finds,
lines.plainText: It is the lesser blot modesty finds

lines.text: Women to change their shapes than men their minds.
lines.plainText: Women to change their shapes than men their minds

lines.text: Than men their minds! 'Tis true. O heaven, were man
lines.plainText: Than men their minds 'Tis true O heaven were man

lines.text: But constant, he were perfect. That one error
lines.plainText: But constant he were perfect That one error

lines.text: Fills him with faults, makes him run through all th' sins;
lines.plainText: Fills him with faults makes him run through all th' sins

lines.text: Inconstancy falls off ere it begins.
lines.plainText: Inconstancy falls off ere it begins

lines.text: What is in Silvia's face but I may spy
lines.plainText: What is in Silvia's face but I may spy

lines.text: More fresh in Julia's with a constant eye?
lines.plainText: More fresh in Julia's with a constant eye

lines.text: Come, come, a hand from either.
lines.plainText: Come come a hand from either

lines.text: Let me be blest to make this happy close.
lines.plainText: Let me be blest to make this happy close

lines.text: 'Twere pity two such friends should be long foes.
lines.plainText: 'Twere pity two such friends should be long foes

lines.text: Bear witness, heaven, I have my wish for ever.
lines.plainText: Bear witness heaven I have my wish for ever

lines.text: And I mine.
lines.plainText: And I mine

content.text: Enter Outlaws with Duke and Thurio.

lines.text: A prize, a prize, a prize!
lines.plainText: A prize a prize a prize

lines.text: Forbear, forbear, I say! It is my lord the Duke.
lines.plainText: Forbear forbear I say It is my lord the Duke

lines.text: Your Grace is welcome to a man disgraced,
lines.plainText: Your Grace is welcome to a man disgraced

lines.text: Banished Valentine.
lines.plainText: Banished Valentine

lines.text: Sir Valentine!
lines.plainText: Sir Valentine

lines.text: Yonder is Silvia, and Silvia's mine.
lines.plainText: Yonder is Silvia and Silvia's mine

lines.text: Thurio, give back, or else embrace thy death;
lines.plainText: Thurio give back or else embrace thy death

lines.text: Come not within the measure of my wrath.
lines.plainText: Come not within the measure of my wrath

lines.text: Do not name Silvia thine; if once again,
lines.plainText: Do not name Silvia thine if once again

lines.text: Verona shall not hold thee. Here she stands;
lines.plainText: Verona shall not hold thee Here she stands

lines.text: Take but possession of her with a touch—
lines.plainText: Take but possession of her with a touch

lines.text: I dare thee but to breathe upon my love.
lines.plainText: I dare thee but to breathe upon my love

lines.text: Sir Valentine, I care not for her, I.
lines.plainText: Sir Valentine I care not for her I

lines.text: I hold him but a fool that will endanger
lines.plainText: I hold him but a fool that will endanger

lines.text: His body for a girl that loves him not.
lines.plainText: His body for a girl that loves him not

lines.text: I claim her not, and therefore she is thine.
lines.plainText: I claim her not and therefore she is thine

lines.text: The more degenerate and base art thou
lines.plainText: The more degenerate and base art thou

lines.text: To make such means for her as thou hast done,
lines.plainText: To make such means for her as thou hast done

lines.text: And leave her on such slight conditions.—
lines.plainText: And leave her on such slight conditions

lines.text: Now, by the honour of my ancestry,
lines.plainText: Now by the honour of my ancestry

lines.text: I do applaud thy spirit, Valentine,
lines.plainText: I do applaud thy spirit Valentine

lines.text: And think thee worthy of an empress' love.
lines.plainText: And think thee worthy of an empress' love

lines.text: Know then, I here forget all former griefs,
lines.plainText: Know then I here forget all former griefs

lines.text: Cancel all grudge, repeal thee home again,
lines.plainText: Cancel all grudge repeal thee home again

lines.text: Plead a new state in thy unrivalled merit,
lines.plainText: Plead a new state in thy unrivalled merit

lines.text: To which I thus subscribe: Sir Valentine,
lines.plainText: To which I thus subscribe Sir Valentine

lines.text: Thou art a gentleman, and well derived;
lines.plainText: Thou art a gentleman and well derived

lines.text: Take thou thy Silvia, for thou hast deserved her.
lines.plainText: Take thou thy Silvia for thou hast deserved her

lines.text: I thank your Grace; the gift hath made me happy.
lines.plainText: I thank your Grace the gift hath made me happy

lines.text: I now beseech you, for your daughter's sake,
lines.plainText: I now beseech you for your daughter's sake

lines.text: To grant one boon that I shall ask of you.
lines.plainText: To grant one boon that I shall ask of you

lines.text: I grant it for thine own, whate'er it be.
lines.plainText: I grant it for thine own whate'er it be

lines.text: These banished men, that I have kept withal,
lines.plainText: These banished men that I have kept withal

lines.text: Are men endued with worthy qualities.
lines.plainText: Are men endued with worthy qualities

lines.text: Forgive them what they have committed here,
lines.plainText: Forgive them what they have committed here

lines.text: And let them be recalled from their exile.
lines.plainText: And let them be recalled from their exile

lines.text: They are reformed, civil, full of good,
lines.plainText: They are reformed civil full of good

lines.text: And fit for great employment, worthy lord.
lines.plainText: And fit for great employment worthy lord

lines.text: Thou hast prevailed; I pardon them and thee.
lines.plainText: Thou hast prevailed I pardon them and thee

lines.text: Dispose of them as thou know'st their deserts.
lines.plainText: Dispose of them as thou know'st their deserts

lines.text: Come, let us go; we will include all jars
lines.plainText: Come let us go we will include all jars

lines.text: With triumphs, mirth, and rare solemnity.
lines.plainText: With triumphs mirth and rare solemnity

lines.text: And as we walk along, I dare be bold
lines.plainText: And as we walk along I dare be bold

lines.text: With our discourse to make your Grace to smile.
lines.plainText: With our discourse to make your Grace to smile

lines.text: What think you of this page, my lord?
lines.plainText: What think you of this page my lord

lines.text: I think the boy hath grace in him; he blushes.
lines.plainText: I think the boy hath grace in him he blushes

lines.text: I warrant you, my lord, more grace than boy.
lines.plainText: I warrant you my lord more grace than boy

lines.text: What mean you by that saying?
lines.plainText: What mean you by that saying

lines.text: Please you, I'll tell you as we pass along,
lines.plainText: Please you I'll tell you as we pass along

lines.text: That you will wonder what hath fortuned.
lines.plainText: That you will wonder what hath fortuned

lines.text: Come, Proteus, 'tis your penance but to hear
lines.plainText: Come Proteus 'tis your penance but to hear

lines.text: The story of your loves discovered.
lines.plainText: The story of your loves discovered

lines.text: That done, our day of marriage shall be yours,
lines.plainText: That done our day of marriage shall be yours

lines.text: One feast, one house, one mutual happiness.
lines.plainText: One feast one house one mutual happiness
